name: Fas associated factor 1
pathways: negative regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction

function.text: FAF1 encodes FAS-associated factor 1. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase regulator activity and NF-kappaB binding. It participates in negative regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and ERAD pathway.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
